stage.units: px of 2400x1600 stage; layers cropped to content bbox

invitationSlot.note: Render the real invitation here (in z-order between the layers marked in README per scene). Nothing is painted into the slot.

01-secret-world.name: glow
01-secret-world.animation: Opacity 0 -> 1 as doors open (1.4s, ease-out). Use mix-blend-mode: screen.

01-secret-world.name: door_left
01-secret-world.animation: Open: translateX(-58%) over 1.6s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.25,1); slides behind L6. Optional 4s delay for suspense. Ends hidden behind frames.

01-secret-world.name: door_right
01-secret-world.animation: Open: translateX(+58%) over 1.6s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.25,1); slides behind L6. Optional 4s delay for suspense. Ends hidden behind frames.

01-secret-world.name: L6_deep_burgundy
01-secret-world.animation: Entrance: translateY(+60px) scale(1.06) opacity 0 -> rest, stagger 450ms from back (L6) to front (L1), 1.1s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1). Idle: tiny parallax (L1 moves most, L6 least).

01-secret-world.name: L5_burgundy
01-secret-world.animation: Entrance: translateY(+60px) scale(1.06) opacity 0 -> rest, stagger 360ms from back (L6) to front (L1), 1.1s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1). Idle: tiny parallax (L1 moves most, L6 least).

01-secret-world.name: L4_rose_burgundy
01-secret-world.animation: Entrance: translateY(+60px) scale(1.06) opacity 0 -> rest, stagger 270ms from back (L6) to front (L1), 1.1s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1). Idle: tiny parallax (L1 moves most, L6 least).

01-secret-world.name: gold_hairlines
01-secret-world.animation: Draw-on: stroke reveal bottom->top via clip-path/inset or mask 1.2s, after arches land. Idle: slow specular sweep.

01-secret-world.name: L3_blush
01-secret-world.animation: Entrance: translateY(+60px) scale(1.06) opacity 0 -> rest, stagger 180ms from back (L6) to front (L1), 1.1s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1). Idle: tiny parallax (L1 moves most, L6 least).

01-secret-world.name: L2_ivory_warm
01-secret-world.animation: Entrance: translateY(+60px) scale(1.06) opacity 0 -> rest, stagger 90ms from back (L6) to front (L1), 1.1s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1). Idle: tiny parallax (L1 moves most, L6 least).

01-secret-world.name: L1_ivory
01-secret-world.animation: Entrance: translateY(+60px) scale(1.06) opacity 0 -> rest, stagger 0ms from back (L6) to front (L1), 1.1s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1). Idle: tiny parallax (L1 moves most, L6 least).

01-secret-world.name: light_rays
01-secret-world.animation: Opacity 0 -> 0.8 with glow; slow translateX(+-12px) loop 14s. mix-blend-mode: screen.

01-secret-world.name: dust
01-secret-world.animation: Idle: translateY(-24px) + opacity breathe 6-9s ease-in-out infinite, alternate. Parallax x1.4 vs frames.

02-living-art.name: bg
02-living-art.animation: Static. Optional very slow scale 1.00->1.025 over 20s.

02-living-art.name: silk_back_sweep
02-living-art.animation: Idle: slow wave — translate(+-10px,+-6px) + skewX(+-1.2deg) 11s sine alternate. Entrance: opacity 0 -> 1 with translateX(-80px), 1.6s.

02-living-art.name: paper_sculpture_left
02-living-art.animation: Entrance: rotate(-8deg) translate(-120px,60px) opacity 0 -> rest 1.4s ease-out. Idle: translateY +-6px / rotate +-0.6deg, 9s sine, alternate.

02-living-art.name: paper_sculpture_right
02-living-art.animation: Entrance: mirror of left, rotate(+8deg) translate(120px,60px). Idle: same, phase-offset 2.5s.

02-living-art.name: silk_veil
02-living-art.role: silk veil (covers invitation, then lifts away)
02-living-art.animation: Reveal: translateY(-115%) + skewX(-6deg) + scaleX(0.88) over 2.2s cubic-bezier(.6,0,.2,1); optionally rotate(-3deg) with transform-origin 50% 0. Add slight opacity fade in last 20%. Hidden/unmounted after.

02-living-art.name: silk_front_left
02-living-art.animation: Entrance: translate(-260px,140px) rotate(-6deg) -> rest 1.8s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.2,1). Idle: translate(+-14px,+-8px) rotate(+-0.8deg) 8s sine alternate.

02-living-art.name: silk_front_right
02-living-art.animation: Entrance: mirror of left (+260px,140px). Idle: same, phase offset 1.8s.

02-living-art.name: gold_thread
02-living-art.animation: Draw-on reveal (stroke from bottom-left to top-right) 1.4s once veil lifts; keep static after.

02-living-art.name: light_sweep
02-living-art.animation: Slow opacity breathe 0.5 -> 1, 10s. mix-blend-mode: soft-light or screen.

03-impossible-invitation.name: bg
03-impossible-invitation.animation: Static. Optional slow scale 1.00->1.02.

03-impossible-invitation.name: R0_base_burgundy
03-impossible-invitation.animation: Assemble: from exploded state translate(0,0) scale(1.50) opacity 0, rotate(2.5deg) -> rest. Stagger 0ms back->front, 1.3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1).

03-impossible-invitation.name: R1_ivory
03-impossible-invitation.animation: Assemble: from exploded state translate(0,0) scale(1.40) opacity 0, rotate(-2.5deg) -> rest. Stagger 110ms back->front, 1.3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1).

03-impossible-invitation.name: R2_champagne
03-impossible-invitation.animation: Assemble: from exploded state translate(0,0) scale(1.30) opacity 0, rotate(2.5deg) -> rest. Stagger 220ms back->front, 1.3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1).

03-impossible-invitation.name: R3_burgundy
03-impossible-invitation.animation: Assemble: from exploded state translate(0,0) scale(1.20) opacity 0, rotate(-2.5deg) -> rest. Stagger 330ms back->front, 1.3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1).

03-impossible-invitation.name: R4_ivory
03-impossible-invitation.animation: Assemble: from exploded state translate(0,0) scale(1.10) opacity 0, rotate(2.5deg) -> rest. Stagger 440ms back->front, 1.3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1).

03-impossible-invitation.name: gold_inlay
03-impossible-invitation.animation: Draw-on: clip-path inset(50% 50% 50% 50%) -> inset(0) 1.2s ease-in-out, after rings land (delay 1500ms). Idle: specular sweep via mask-position, 8s.

03-impossible-invitation.name: fin_L1
03-impossible-invitation.animation: Assemble: translateY(-420px) opacity 0 -> rest, 1.2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), delay 500ms. Idle: translateY(+-5px) 7s sine alternate, phase offset 0.0s.

03-impossible-invitation.name: fin_R1
03-impossible-invitation.animation: Assemble: translateY(-420px) opacity 0 -> rest, 1.2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), delay 545ms. Idle: translateY(+-5px) 7s sine alternate, phase offset 0.0s.

03-impossible-invitation.name: fin_L2
03-impossible-invitation.animation: Assemble: translateY(+480px) opacity 0 -> rest, 1.2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), delay 590ms. Idle: translateY(+-5px) 7s sine alternate, phase offset 0.7s.

03-impossible-invitation.name: fin_R2
03-impossible-invitation.animation: Assemble: translateY(+480px) opacity 0 -> rest, 1.2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), delay 635ms. Idle: translateY(+-5px) 7s sine alternate, phase offset 0.7s.

03-impossible-invitation.name: fin_L3
03-impossible-invitation.animation: Assemble: translateY(-540px) opacity 0 -> rest, 1.2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), delay 680ms. Idle: translateY(+-5px) 7s sine alternate, phase offset 1.4s.

03-impossible-invitation.name: fin_R3
03-impossible-invitation.animation: Assemble: translateY(-540px) opacity 0 -> rest, 1.2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), delay 725ms. Idle: translateY(+-5px) 7s sine alternate, phase offset 1.4s.

03-impossible-invitation.name: fin_L4
03-impossible-invitation.animation: Assemble: translateY(+600px) opacity 0 -> rest, 1.2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), delay 770ms. Idle: translateY(+-5px) 7s sine alternate, phase offset 2.1s.

03-impossible-invitation.name: fin_R4
03-impossible-invitation.animation: Assemble: translateY(+600px) opacity 0 -> rest, 1.2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), delay 815ms. Idle: translateY(+-5px) 7s sine alternate, phase offset 2.1s.

03-impossible-invitation.name: fin_L5
03-impossible-invitation.animation: Assemble: translateY(-660px) opacity 0 -> rest, 1.2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), delay 860ms. Idle: translateY(+-5px) 7s sine alternate, phase offset 2.8s.

03-impossible-invitation.name: fin_R5
03-impossible-invitation.animation: Assemble: translateY(-660px) opacity 0 -> rest, 1.2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), delay 905ms. Idle: translateY(+-5px) 7s sine alternate, phase offset 2.8s.

03-impossible-invitation.name: lintel_top
03-impossible-invitation.animation: Assemble: translateY(-260px) scaleX(0.7) -> rest, 1.1s, delay 900ms.

03-impossible-invitation.name: lintel_bottom
03-impossible-invitation.animation: Assemble: translateY(+260px) scaleX(0.7) -> rest, 1.1s, delay 980ms.

03-impossible-invitation.name: lintel_top_thin
03-impossible-invitation.animation: Assemble: translateY(-200px) -> rest, 1.1s, delay 1000ms.

03-impossible-invitation.name: lintel_bottom_thin
03-impossible-invitation.animation: Assemble: translateY(+200px) -> rest, 1.1s, delay 1060ms.

03-impossible-invitation.name: tab_1
03-impossible-invitation.animation: Floats toward viewer: translate(+-30px,+-20px) scale(1.15) opacity 0 -> rest, 1.4s, delay 1100ms. Idle: parallax x1.6 on pointer move.

03-impossible-invitation.name: tab_2
03-impossible-invitation.animation: Floats toward viewer: translate(+-30px,+-20px) scale(1.15) opacity 0 -> rest, 1.4s, delay 1100ms. Idle: parallax x1.6 on pointer move.

03-impossible-invitation.name: tab_3
03-impossible-invitation.animation: Floats toward viewer: translate(+-30px,+-20px) scale(1.15) opacity 0 -> rest, 1.4s, delay 1100ms. Idle: parallax x1.6 on pointer move.

03-impossible-invitation.name: tab_4
03-impossible-invitation.animation: Floats toward viewer: translate(+-30px,+-20px) scale(1.15) opacity 0 -> rest, 1.4s, delay 1100ms. Idle: parallax x1.6 on pointer move.

03-impossible-invitation.name: light_sweep
03-impossible-invitation.animation: Opacity breathe 0.6 -> 1, 9s; slow translateX(+-30px). mix-blend-mode: soft-light or screen.
